Analysis of Push Notification Metrics for Bus Operators

1. DELIVERY PERFORMANCE

The delivery performance of the push notifications is currently at:

  • Sent: 0
  • Delivered: 0
  • Delivery Rate: 0%

This indicates a significant issue with the push notification system, as the delivery rate is well below the acceptable threshold of 60%. The absence of any sent or delivered notifications suggests that there may be a critical failure in the notification system, possibly due to:

  • System notification failures
  • Configuration issues preventing notifications from being sent
  • Technical glitches or outages affecting the push notification service

2. ENGAGEMENT DEPTH

Since there have been no notifications sent or delivered, the click-to-delivered rate cannot be calculated. This lack of engagement implies that the notifications, if they were to be sent, are not reaching the intended audience, making it impossible to assess their relevance or effectiveness.

3. OPERATIONAL IMPACT

With no push notifications being successfully delivered, there is no associated click volume to analyze. Consequently, we cannot link push notification success to platform engagement, such as activity on Hisab or Dashboard. The absence of engagement metrics indicates a need for immediate investigation into the push notification system to restore functionality.

In summary, the current state of push notifications for bus operators is concerning, with a complete lack of delivery and engagement. Urgent action is required to identify and resolve the underlying issues affecting the notification system.
